query:
SELECT u.id
           FROM users u
           JOIN accounts a ON a.id = u.account_id
           WHERE a.domain IS NULL
             AND u.approved
             AND u.confirmed_at IS NOT NULL
             AND a.suspended_at IS NULL
             AND a.requested_deletion_at IS NULL
             AND ($1::bigint IS NULL OR a.id = $1)
           ORDER BY u.id
